tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen and page background. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ember, amber, approve, reject.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels, chips, command bar. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and gridlines only. Under 3:1, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning (queued chip, dashed empty card). 3:1 or better on surface and ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and white indicator light on ground, surface, surface-raised, kill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on ground, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Brand accent: blocked state, active tab, wordmark. Text on ground uses it directly; text on it uses ground.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Working state and agent LEDs. Text on it uses ground.

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: Safe, done and APPROVE only. Never decoration. Text on it uses on-approve.

tokens.name: on-approve
tokens.usage: Text and icons on approve fills.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: REJECT only. Never used for generic errors or warnings.

tokens.name: kill
tokens.usage: KILL switch cap and the KILL ACTIVE banner only. Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: collar
tokens.usage: Yellow collar around the kill switch. Hardware only.

tokens.name: acrylic
tokens.usage: Edge tint and highlights of clear 3 mm acrylic. Use at 10 to 35 percent fill, solid for edges.

tokens.name: plywood
tokens.usage: Warm 3 mm plywood front panel variant. Text on it uses ply-ink.

tokens.name: ply-ink
tokens.usage: Engraved or printed labels on plywood. 7:1 on plywood.

tokens.name: ply-grain
tokens.usage: Grain lines and edge shading on plywood.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Metal parts: PTT button, screws, toggle, standoffs.

tokens.name: steel-dark
tokens.usage: Shadow side of metal parts and button bezels.

tokens.name: bezel
tokens.usage: 3D-printed screen bezel and microphone body.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: Raspberry Pi board. Deliberately not green so green keeps its meaning.

tokens.name: perf
tokens.usage: Perfboard.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Desk or table surface in scenes.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: dash-label
styles.usage: Panel headers, uppercase in English only. Never letter-space Chinese.

styles.name: dash-mono
styles.usage: Task ids, tool calls, shell commands.

styles.name: mini-name
styles.usage: Agent name and state on the 5 inch screen.

styles.name: mini-detail
styles.usage: One short detail line under each agent row.

styles.name: panel-label
styles.usage: Printed or engraved labels, English above Chinese.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on screens.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen margin and panel gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Perfboard dot pitch on the cover; large gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap in documentation pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Acrylic and plywood panel corners in drawings, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tool cards, command bar on screens.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels on screens.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the mode switch.
